summary.zh: 同一个包，同时支持 DSH Go 手机 App（原生界面）和 DSH 网页端：盯住答题页面，把每道题的答案弹成顶部通知，优先命中本地题库、没有就调模型。网页端可直接选本地文件导入题库（手机选手机文件，电脑选电脑文件）。
summary.en: One package for both DSH Go (native phone app) and the DSH Web UI: watches the quiz page and pops each answer as a heads-up notification — local question bank first, model fallback. In the Web UI you can import a question bank by picking a local file.
